notes.title: Soon :D :D !! New Trailer and Release Date :D !
Soon :D :D !! New Trailer and Release Date :D !
New big game mechanic added : Power UP !! (Available in Release)
notes.notes:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26943504/275b732e0fd270508c10b884e17dbc00ac4a6986.png
DragoDino, Power Up System : 
- three slots,
- multiple type of Power Up available randomly during the game,
- each power up upgrades one DragoDino's skill or something else,
=> Free to choose your own combination to enhance your play style ;) !
